_comment: Held deliberately identical to Pro apart from two things, so an A/B between them measures the model and nothing else. The two exceptions are the point of the tier, not an oversight: Reflection does not run (Substrates:Agents:Reflection:UseSubstrate false), and there is no context window. Everything else -- sentence budget, perception width, recall depth, mood -- matches Pro on purpose. If you change a Knobs value here, change it in appsettings.Pro.json too or the next comparison is measuring your edit.
